text:
First of all, thanks for offering the possibility for ordering in English. However, most of the steps in the ordering process are still in Spanish. If you have no spanish proficiency at all, it is useless. The provided pictures are all from the English menu 😅.

Secondly, we asked the order to be brought to our table and took a number. Even so, I heard our order number being called out. It was not being brought to our table, I came to get it myself.

Finally, and most importantly, I am used to McDonalds having a consistent quality of food. All around the world, you know what to expect, and you get what you expect. Except for this place: the chicken nuggets were not crispy anymore, the fries were soft, and the coca cola was served lukewarm and without ice.

The second chance occurred when I ordered a McFlurry. Again, I waited for 15 minutes. When I went to the pickup counter, they sent me to the ice-cream counter. At the ice-cream counter, they send me back to the main counter. Finally, someone started to acknowledge that I didn't get my icecream and started making it. When it was finally delivered, it felt like it wasn't a full portion.. see picture.

Do not expect the usual McDonald's quality.
author: Joep van der Weijden

text:
Minimal training of staff, who are nice but sluggish at best.  Certainly NOT the "gringo" version of this restaurant.
Serving food hot is optional and accidental in Peru.  Be prepared to be served many things tepid.  You might think French Fries need to be hot, but no, not here.  This and all other McDonald's'  in Peru never got the memo concerning the importance of serving their items hot.

Retarded management knows they can hire these employees at about $1 per hour so they flood the zone with crew.  Yet they are always "in the weeds". Corporate doesn't seem to mind or care about this market too much, that is, they threw all restaurant concepts overboard when the sleek marketing metrics arrived.  Why care about product quality when you can quickly determine which ad campaigns are driving eaters into the shop?

Sluggish, tepid, and sometimes alarmingly unfresh.  Brace yourself. Open 24 hours! Prices are about what you would expect, but a VERY limited selection--NO shakes!
author: William T.' Bud ' Barry
